elevate.move: Make photography the thermometer: fill each reading's frame with an approved photo graded to its temperature (washed warm at 104°, storm grey at 88°, blue-hour slab at 34°, frost-blue mono at -8°), and use the same image inside the hero -8° mask so the page reads as one shoot told as a falling temperature, with the line art kept only as a thin label overlay.

Rebuild the first screen as one frosted window: a single full-width -8° reading bleeding off the right edge with the photo showing through and frost clearing from the centre, the h1 set on its lower edge with the stamp-boxed spring price as proof, sized so the paper band peeks at 1440 and the reading cannot be misread as 8°.
